mapper.sql: id, fact_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, parent_fact_id, supersedes_fact_id, client_id, entity_no, local_partner_id, finance_entity_id, currency, gross_amount, business_time, balance_available_time, status, fact_version, maker_id, checker_id, approved_time, published_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_billing_fact (id, fact_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, parent_fact_id, supersedes_fact_id, client_id, entity_no, local_partner_id, finance_entity_id, currency, gross_amount, business_time, balance_available_time, status, fact_version, maker_id, checker_id, approved_time, published_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{factType}, #{originType}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceEventKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{sourcePayloadHash}, #{parentFactId}, #{supersedesFactId}, #{clientId}, #{entityNo}, #{localPartnerId}, #{financeEntityId}, #{currency}, #{grossAmount}, #{businessTime}, #{balanceAvailableTime}, #{status}, #{factVersion}, #{makerId}, #{checkerId}, #{approvedTime}, #{publishedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_billing_fact WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND source_event_key = #{sourceEventKey}
SELECT FROM t_billing_fact WHERE supersedes_fact_id = #{supersedesFactId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM t_billing_fact WHERE parent_fact_id = #{parentFactId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_billing_fact SET status = 'APPROVED', fact_version = #{factVersion}, checker_id = #{checkerId}, approved_time = #{now}, business_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND fact_version = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, MAX(CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL THEN id END) AS max_pending_fact_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN published_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_fact_count, MAX(CASE WHEN published_at IS NOT NULL THEN id END) AS max_published_fact_id FROM t_billing_fact WHERE AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED')
